title: Book Two · Chapter 98: The Afternoon He Wins
story:
On the last full Wednesday of term, Ronan has a very good game. He does not stop to think about each catch. His hands move to the ball. His throws reach the right part of the wall. He stays steady on his feet.

Jun misses first. Leo misses next. Ronan catches the last ball and holds it high.

“One round,” Jun says.

“Mine.”

They start again. Leo throws faster. Ronan steps sideways and catches it close to his chest. He sends a careful throw toward Jun. Jun reaches too far and drops it.

By the end of the second round, Ronan has won again. He cannot stop smiling. He looks at the two others and lifts two fingers.

“Two.”

“We can count,” Leo says.

Ronan gives a little bow. Jun throws the ball gently toward his feet. Ronan catches that too. All three laugh.

They sit in the shade for water. Ronan wants another round. He thinks he can win three times today. Leo wants to leave early, because his family has an evening visit. Jun has school work to finish.

“Tomorrow?” Ronan asks.

“Maybe,” Jun says. “Not a promise.”

Ronan looks at the ball in his lap. It is still warm from the ground. He likes being good at something with both friends beside him. He is winning now. He does not want the afternoon to end.

Then he sees Leo close his water bottle and stand.

“All right,” Ronan says. “Two is enough for today.”

Leo grins. “For you.”

On the walk home, Ronan passes Mr Qiu's doorway. The books are inside on the low shelf. A customer stands at the table with a child. Ronan waits. They move aside, and he passes.

Mr Qiu asks about school. Ronan tells him the term is nearly over. He also mentions the game, but not the possible booklet. That work is not agreed yet, and he has not done it.

At home, Dad is back earlier than usual. Ronan offers to show Dad his best catch. Dad stands in the yard and throws slowly. Ronan catches it with one hand.

“Too easy,” he says.

Dad throws a little higher. The ball touches Ronan's fingers and falls behind him.

Dad lifts one finger. “One.”

Ronan points toward the kitchen. Mum is watching from the door.

“He is counting already.”

Mum smiles. “I heard about two before I heard hello.”

Ronan looks from her to Dad.

“I was going to tell you.”

“After the third round?”

“Perhaps.”

Dad picks up the ball. He keeps it between his hands while Ronan moves nearer.

Ronan wants to show the fast catch from school. Dad has only seen the easy one and the ball that went past him.

He lifts both hands, then lowers them.

“How do you want it?” Dad asks.

“Not too easy.”

Dad smiles. He turns the ball once before he gets ready.

Ronan looks at Mum again. She has put her work down for a moment and is leaning against the door.

“You can watch this one.”

“I am.”

He stands with his feet a little farther apart. The first two wins are still his, even if the next ball goes wrong. He feels pleased to be in the yard, with someone else holding the ball and both parents watching him.

Ronan picks up the ball. “Hello, Mum,” he says very clearly. Then he starts another small game with Dad.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

win＝赢；round＝一轮；steady＝平稳的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样赢得球赛？
2. 他赢后怎样和朋友相处？

## 读句子

**Ronan / catches the last ball / and holds it high.** Ronan／接住最后一球／把它高高举起。
